outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: 100 pregnant women at term with prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM) and an unfavourable Bishop score, excluding those with previous uterine surgery, palpable uterine contractions, or contraindications to vaginal delivery.
finding: Oral misoprostol resulted in a significantly shorter mean duration of induction to delivery time compared to vaginal PGE2 gel in pregnant females with PROM and a poor Bishop score at term.
mod_finding: No significant difference in the rates of vaginal delivery (82% vs 80%) or caesarean section (18% vs 20%) was concluded between the oral misoprostol and PGE2 gel groups.
